mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate being above 4.5% (which is the current level) causes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of time periods when FEDFUNDS is observed.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and the unemployment rate is below 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1400 thousand units, the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1400 thousand units and industrial production exceeds 110 (index 2017=100), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1400 and INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales exceed 370000 million dollars, the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 370000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 112 (index 2017=100), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 112.
